# Requirement traceability

**Generated by `node tools/traceability.js`. Do not edit by hand.**

A hand-maintained version of this table would be correct on the day it was written
and quietly wrong forever after, while still being cited as evidence. This one is
rebuilt from the GDD and from what the repository actually references, so the
convention of naming requirement ids in comments is the trace link itself.

| Metric | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Requirements in the GDD | 125 |
| Referenced by a test | 55 |
| Referenced only by implementation | 62 |
| Waived, with a stated reason | 8 |
| Unreferenced and unwaived | 0 |

`Referenced only by implementation` is not a failure — a good deal of the GDD is
content policy that a schema or a validator enforces rather than a unit test. It is
listed separately so the difference stays visible.
